properties.note: Reconstructed: Neill says only 'then to Red River'. In 1842 the only established cart route north was the Minnesota Valley / West Plains trail (Hess 1989): up the Minnesota past Traverse des Sioux and Lac qui Parle to Lake Traverse, then the Lake Agassiz beach ridge west of the Red to Pembina and down the Red to St. Boniface. The gravestone says they reached St. Boniface in 1841; Neill's itinerary puts it in 1842.
